text:
Predicates:
Game(x) ::: x is a game.
CreatedBy(x, y) ::: x is created by y.
JapaneseCompany(y) ::: y is a Japanese game company.
OnTop10(x) ::: x is on the Top 10 list.
SoldMoreThanOneMillionCopies(x) ::: x sold more than one million copies.
IncludedInTop10(x) ::: x is included in the Top 10 list.
Premises:
CreatedBy(theLegendOfZelda, y) ∧ JapaneseCompany(y) ::: The Legend of Zelda was created by a Japanese game company.
∀x (OnTop10(x) → ∃y (CreatedBy(x, y) ∧ JapaneseCompany(y))) ::: All games on the Top 10 list are made by Japanese game companies.
∀x (SoldMoreThanOneMillionCopies(x) → IncludedInTop10(x)) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it will be included in the Top 10 list.
SoldMoreThanOneMillionCopies(theLegendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.
Conclusion:
¬OnTop10(theLegendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda is not on the Top 10 list.
